source.name: ATP Tour - Nitto extends as title sponsor of the ATP Finals through 2030
source.note: Nitto Denko extends as title sponsor of the season-finale ATP Finals in Turin through 2030; the 2026 edition runs 15-22 Nov 2026 at the Inalpi Arena.

note: Event title sponsorship recorded as an org deal because the event-host shape does not exist; start year 2017 is the Nitto deal's commonly cited start and was not re-verified against a primary source here.
